values: 一名活泼灵动的法师，擅长为数名敌人施加控制效果。
A lively and agile Mage, skilled at inflicting control effects on multiple enemies.
让我看看，今天的你会做个什么样的梦呢？
What kind of dream will we have today?
就像是做了一场美梦一样！
你好，我们在梦里见过吗？
Hello, I think I've seen you in my dreams.
嗨，你好呀，你也想要去梦里转转吗？
Hi! How are ya? Wanna take a stroll in our dreams?
Hmmm... ah... Perfect! Where are those beautiful dreams?
May your dreams be always perfect.
太棒了！我今晚一定会梦见它的！谢谢你！
I'll be dreaming about this gift tonight. Thank you!
哇，这是我一直想要的礼物！
在无数的梦境中翩然起舞。
深沉的夜晚，幽暗的梦境，神秘的身影。
An eerie dream and a mysterious figure on a somber night.
金玫瑰高定商店兑换获得。
和朋友们待在一起的感觉很好
It's nice to spend time with friends.
大家在思考时就埋下了梦的种子……
When you think about something, you plant it in your dream...
Too bad there's no nectar here.
Will people dream of snowflakes tonight?
This feels just like a dream!
Let's dream of colors bursting brilliantly!
塔西能自如地在梦境中穿梭，她喜欢在不同的梦境里游览，但不知从什么时候起，世界上的噩梦越来越多。
Tasi moves effortlessly through dreams, relishing her trips through different dreamscapes, but somehow, there are more and more nightmares in the world now.
塔西爱打扮，尤其喜欢对着溪流的倒影装扮，对她来说，整洁优雅的仪表，是进入梦境前必备的礼仪。
Tasi enjoys dressing up, particularly while admiring her reflection in the water. For her, neatness and grace are essential preparations before entering someone's dream.
塔西喜欢捉弄人，尤其是迷途进入森林的人。她引导他们打翻叶角熊的蜂蜜，在被追赶逃命时，又让他们“偶然”发现湖中的金币。她非常了解如何让人做一个跌宕难忘的梦。

Tasi enjoys teasing people, particularly those lost in the woods. She'll lead them to a hornleaf bear, and while they're running in fear, she'll ensure they "accidentally" stumble upon gold. She knows exactly how to craft an unforgettable dream.
塔西同情常被噩梦困扰的善良的人，因此偶尔会带做噩梦的人去美梦里逛一逛。
Tasi feels for those plagued by nightmares, so she sometimes brings them to visit beautiful dream worlds.
塔西知道很多小秘密，即使是本人都不曾发觉、不愿承认的憎恨和爱慕，她也了解得一清二楚。用她自己的话来说：“没有人能控制梦境，梦境最诚实。”

Tasi knows all kinds of little secrets—even feelings of love and hate that people don't realize they have or refuse to admit. As she likes to say, "No one controls dreams. They're the most honest part of us."
塔西发现奥曼斯的梦常常是美丽的自然风光，这对她来说可太棒了！她终于找到了一个可以时常光顾的好去处！
Tasi found that Ulmus often dreams of stunning natural landscapes, which is perfect for her. She's finally found a place she can visit regularly.
塔西喜欢明亮的阳光，云朵里流淌的彩虹，风中刮来的稻香味。与之相对，她不喜欢城镇中齿轮和机械的摩擦声，而在所有事物中，她最讨厌的是——战争兵器。

Tasi loves the warm sunshine, rainbows flowing through the clouds, and the smell of wheat fields carried by the breeze. But she can't stand the grinding noise of gears and machines in the cities, and she absolutely loathes weapons of war.
塔西认为衡量一颗心的寿命，应该从对世界抱有的好奇和期待来考量，在这一点上，她认为自己比大多数孩童还要年轻。
Tasi believes that the lifespan of a person should be measured by their curiosity and wonder for the world. And in that sense, she thinks she's younger than most children.
塔西喜欢蝴蝶，这种和她一样有美丽翅膀的可爱小生物，让她感觉非常亲切熟悉。
Tasi loves butterflies. These delicate little creatures with their beautiful wings remind her of herself, and they feel very familiar to her.
塔西唯一弄不清的就是自己会不会做梦，她太好奇了，如果遇到第二个能进入梦境的人，她一定邀请对方进入自己的梦境看看。

The only thing Tasi can't figure out is whether she can dream herself. She's dying to know, and if she ever meets someone else who can enter dreams, she'd definitely invite them to explore hers together.
呀！奥萝菈，你怎么一副没睡醒的样子？
Hey, Aurora! Why do you look so sleepy?
塔西 & 奥萝菈 & 桑尼
我已经很久没有见到过妖精了……上一次，是什么时候来着？
It's been a long time since I last saw a fairy. I don't even remember when the last time was.
和朋友们待在一起的感觉很好
It's nice to spend time with friends.
Too bad there's no nectar here.
隆冬节快到了，真怀念呀。
The Winter Carnival is almost here, and I can't help but feel a sense of excitement bubbling up.
Will people dream of snowflakes tonight?
This feels just like a dream!
Let's dream of colors bursting brilliantly!
